tools.name: check_robots
tools.description: Read a site's robots.txt and report, for 17 search and AI crawlers (GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, ClaudeBot, Claude-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, Googlebot, Bingbot, CCBot, Google-Extended and more), whether each may fetch the home page and an optional path, and which rule decides. Uses RFC 9309

tools.name: check_agent_listings
tools.description: Check whether a product can be listed in AI agent directories: the official MCP Registry, the Claude Connectors Directory, ChatGPT apps (OpenAI plugin directory), skills.sh and Manus. tools.name: scan_site
tools.description: Start a full scan of a public website that the user names. The scan requests each page the way common search and AI crawlers do, compares each response with a rendered browser view, and scores six SEO, AEO and GEO categories. Each scan counts against the user's monthly plan quota. Returns a scan_id.

tools.name: get_scan
tools.description: Status, progress and summary of a scan: overall score and band, category scores, technical health, Domain Rating, rendering mode, platform and the top issues. Set wait_seconds (up to 25) to wait for a running scan to finish.

tools.name: list_issues
tools.description: All issues found by a completed scan, most severe first, with details and example URLs. Filter by minimum severity or category.

tools.name: get_internal_links
tools.description: The newest internal link plan for one of the user's sites (paid plans): where words already on one page should link to another page, with the Search Console query and average position behind each anchor. tools.name: list_scans
tools.description: The user's recent scans, newest first, with score and status.

tools.name: get_plan_pass_quote
tools.description: The user's current plan and the price of each prepaid plan pass (Starter, Pro, Agency; 1 month or 1 year), with whether the account can buy it and until when it would run. Takes no payment and changes nothing.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "scan_site" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Start a full scan of a website: each page is requested separately as Googlebot, Bingbot, GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot and CCBot, compared with a rendered browser view, and scored across six SEO, AEO and GEO categories, with technical health and Domain Rating. Uses the API key owner's plan quota." → after: "Start a full scan of a public website that the user names. The scan requests each page the way common search and AI crawlers do, compares each response with a rendered browser view, and scores six SEO, AEO and GEO categories. Each scan counts against the user's monthly plan quota. Returns a scan_id."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
